_how_to_add: Add an entry to a category's 'items' list, then run: python3 _build.py. These are public resources we point to. Formal partners go in _src/data/partners.json instead, so they get a featured card and a spot in the partner logo strip.

categories.title: Professional football
categories.intro: Clubs, academies, trials, and development programs that offer real pathways for players finishing college soccer, in the United States and abroad.

categories.title: Education and scholarships
categories.intro: Graduate programs, scholarships, and international study options for athletes who want to keep learning, on or off the pitch.

categories.title: Career development
categories.intro: Employers, mentorship programs, and career services that understand what athletes bring to a workplace.

categories.title: Health and wellbeing
categories.intro: Physical recovery, mental health, and wellbeing support for the body and mind after competitive sport.

items.name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
items.desc: Free, confidential support 24/7 in the United States. Call or text 988, or chat online, if you or someone you know is struggling.

categories.title: Athlete transition
categories.intro: Organizations and programs focused on life after competitive sport: identity, purpose, and the practical steps of starting over.
